slug: 2026-04-17 Mozambique parliament unanimously approves Cyber Security Law

facts.fact: Parliament unanimously approved a cyber security law on 2026-04-17 creating a new institution in the public administration, with the National Institute of Communications (INCM) as technical coordinator and a National Cyber Security Authority named in Article 12 of the law.
facts.system: National Cyber Security Authority (INCM as technical coordinator)

systems.system: National Cyber Security Authority (INCM as technical coordinator)
